topic: A New Year's card for the 田中 family
title_jp: {年賀状|ねんがじょう}を{書く|かく}
context: Friday 25 December: Christmas Day is an ordinary workday in Japan, and the last day to post {年賀状|ねんがじょう} so they arrive on 1 January. At the kotatsu, アルちゃん writes his card to the {田中|たなか} family, with a handwritten line for each of them.
scene: Christmas Day, an ordinary Friday in Japan. Today's the last day to post New Year's cards. You write one to the {田中|たなか} family.

phrases.jp: いつもお{世話|せわ|care, looking after|3}になってばかりで、すみません。
phrases.en: I'm always relying on you, sorry.
phrases.note: Humble thanks: 'all I do is receive your help'.

phrases.jp: {昨年|さくねん|last year (formal)|3}は{大変|たいへん}お{世話|せわ|care, looking after|3}になりました。
phrases.en: Thank you for everything last year.
phrases.note: The classic {年賀状|ねんがじょう} line. Never {去年|きょねん} on a New Year card.

phrases.jp: {本年|ほんねん|this year (formal)|2}もよろしくお{願い|ねがい}いたします。
phrases.en: I look forward to your kindness this year too.

phrases.jp: {寝て|ねて}ばかりいないで、{手伝って|てつだって}よ。
phrases.en: Stop lying around and help me!
phrases.note: Family telling-off: 〜てばかりいないで.

phrases.jp: {皆様|みなさま|everyone (polite)|3}のご{健康|けんこう|health|3}をお{祈り|いのり|to pray, wish for|3}しております。
phrases.en: I wish you all good health.
phrases.note: Formal closing for cards and letters.

dialogue_setting: Your room above the {田中|たなか} house, Christmas morning. A New Year's card with a printed greeting, and your handwriting underneath.
text_title: {田中|たなか}{家|け}への{年賀状|ねんがじょう|New Year's card|3}

dialogue.speaker: Greeting
dialogue.jp: {謹賀新年|きんがしんねん|Happy New Year (formal)|2}　あけましておめでとうございます。

dialogue.speaker: Thanks
dialogue.jp: {昨年|さくねん|last year (formal)|3}は、{右も左も分からない|みぎもひだりもわからない|knowing nothing at all|2}{私|わたし}を、{家族|かぞく}のように{迎えて|むかえて}くださり、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.en: Last year you welcomed me like family, when I didn't know my left from my right. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Thanks
dialogue.jp: {畑|はたけ|field (crops)|3}でも{家|いえ}でも、お{世話|せわ|care, looking after|3}になってばかりでした。
dialogue.en: On the farm and at home, I did nothing but rely on you.

dialogue.speaker: Wish
dialogue.jp: {本年|ほんねん|this year (formal)|2}もどうぞよろしくお{願い|ねがい}{申し上げます|もうしあげます|to say (humble)|2}。
dialogue.en: I humbly ask for your kindness this year as well.

dialogue.speaker: Date
dialogue.jp: {令和|れいわ}9{年|ねん}　{元旦|がんたん|New Year's morning|2}

dialogue.speaker: Handwritten 1
dialogue.jp: {田中|たなか}さん、{今年|ことし}は{雪かき|ゆきかき}も{剪定|せんてい|pruning (trees)|1}も、もっと{役に立てる|やくにたてる|to be useful|3}よう{頑張ります|がんばります}。
dialogue.en: {田中|たなか}さん, this year I'll work hard to be more useful, with the snow and the pruning.

dialogue.speaker: Handwritten 2
dialogue.jp: {恵子|けいこ}さんのご{飯|はん}を{食べて|たべて}ばかりで、{少し|すこし}{太りました|ふとりました|to put on weight|4}（{笑|わら}）。
dialogue.en: I've done nothing but eat {恵子|けいこ}さん's cooking, and I've put on a bit of weight (lol).

dialogue.speaker: Handwritten 3
dialogue.jp: {颯太|そうた}へ　{冬休み|ふゆやすみ}、ゲームしてばかりいないで、{一緒に|いっしょに}{雪だるま|ゆきだるま|snowman|3}{作ろう|つくろう}！
dialogue.en: To {颯太|そうた}: this winter break, don't just play video games, let's build a snowman together!

listening.intro: {恵子|けいこ}さん calls up the stairs about your cards. Type what she says.

lines.jp: {今日|きょう}までに{出せば|だせば}、{元日|がんじつ}に{届く|とどく}よ。
lines.en: If you post them by today, they'll arrive on New Year's Day.

grammar.form: て-form + ばかりいる ({食|た}べてばかりいる, {寝|ね}てばかりいる) · past: 〜てばかりいた / 〜てばかりだった · telling off: 〜てばかりいないで (ゲームしてばかりいないで)
grammar.explanation: Says someone does one thing all the time, usually as a complaint or a joke: 'all you do is…'. In thanks it turns humble: お{世話|せわ}になってばかりで = 'I've only taken your help'. Not たばかり ('just did').
mark: ゲームしてばかりいないで

examples.jp: {健太|けんた}は{仕事中|しごとちゅう}、{文句|もんく|complaint|3}を{言って|いって}ばかりいる。
examples.en: At work {健太|けんた} does nothing but complain.

examples.jp: {雪|ゆき}の{日|ひ}は、こたつで{寝て|ねて}ばかりだった。
examples.en: On snowy days, all I did was sleep under the kotatsu.

quiz.question: {颯太|そうた}は{冬休み|ふゆやすみ}、ゲームを＿＿いる。
quiz.en: This winter break, all {颯太|そうた} does is play games.
quiz.explain: て-form + ばかりいる = doing nothing but that.

quiz_more.question: さっきご{飯|はん}を{食べた|たべた}＿＿だから、お{腹|なか}いっぱい。
quiz_more.en: I've only just eaten, so I'm full.
quiz_more.explain: た-form + ばかり = 'just did'. てばかり is 'all the time'.

quiz_more.question: {笑って|わらって}＿＿いないで、{手伝って|てつだって}よ！
quiz_more.en: Stop just laughing and help me!
quiz_more.explain: 〜てばかりいないで = stop doing only that.

kanji.where: Printed in gold at the top of the card you bought at the post office.
kanji.breakdown: {謹賀新年|きんがしんねん}: {謹|きん} respectfully + {賀|が} celebrate + {新年|しんねん} new year → 'I respectfully celebrate the New Year'.
kanji.related: {賀正|がしょう} and {迎春|げいしゅん} are shorter printed greetings.

tip.title: Writing {年賀状|ねんがじょう}
tip.body: Cards posted from 15 to 25 December are delivered on 1 January. On them, write {昨年|さくねん}, not {去年|きょねん}: {去|さ}る means 'to leave', a bad word for New Year. The short handwritten line under the printed greeting is the part people really read.

challenge.prompt: Your card to {佐藤|さとう}{先生|せんせい} has a printed greeting; under it you write a line. One part is wrong for a teacher.

parts.jp: {大変|たいへん}お{世話|せわ}になりました。

parts.why: Far too casual for {佐藤|さとう}{先生|せんせい}: use よろしくお{願|ねが}いいたします.

challenge.model_answer: {昨年|さくねん}は{大変|たいへん}お{世話|せわ|care, looking after|3}になりました。{本年|ほんねん}もよろしくお{願い|ねがい}いたします。
challenge.explanation: {昨年|さくねん} and {本年|ほんねん} are the formal words for last year and this year. お{世話|せわ}になりました thanks someone for their help, and お{願|ねが}いいたします is the humble form of お{願|ねが}いします, right for a teacher you work with.
challenge.hint: keep the whole card in keigo

vocab.note: お{世話|せわ}になる = be helped by; {世話|せわ}をする = look after.
Formal {去年|きょねん}. Like {昨日|さくじつ} for {昨日|きのう}.
Formal {今年|ことし}: cards, speeches, shop notices.
Very humble {言|い}う. お{願|ねが}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます on cards.
{役|やく}に{立|た}てる = be able to help. {役|やく}に{立|た}たない = useless.
{太|ふと}った = got fat (state: {太|ふと}っている). Opposite: {痩|や}せる.
Named after the round Daruma doll. Japanese ones have two balls, not three.
{健康|けんこう}に{良|い}い = good for you. ご{健康|けんこう} in polite writing.
お{祈|いの}りしております = I wish you (polite). Also at shrines.

kanji_study.parts: 亻 person + 建 build → a person who is well built: healthy. You know it from {健太|けんた}'s name ('healthy and big').
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 建 (build): 建 has no 亻 person on the left.

kanji_study.parts: 丷 hair on top + 自 a face with its nose → a head: neck, head, and the 'head' of a country.
kanji_study.lookalike: Inside 道 (road) you'll find 首 walking on 辶.

items.jp: {本年|ほんねん|this year (formal)|2}もご{指導|しどう|guidance|2}のほど、よろしくお{願い|ねがい}いたします。
items.en: I ask for your guidance this year too.

items.jp: お{正月|しょうがつ}は{食べて|たべて}{寝て|ねて}ばかりだった。
items.en: All I did at New Year was eat and sleep.

items.jp: {謝って|あやまって}ばかりいないで、{笑って|わらって}よ。
items.en: Stop apologising all the time, smile!

items.jp: {最近|さいきん}、{雪|ゆき}が{降って|ふって}ばかりだね。
items.en: It's been doing nothing but snow lately.
